text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer of the Senior Class. Even with 
regional expeditions on the horizon, 
Matikanefukukitaru dove straight into 
summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Summer has arrived— Cicadas piercing the 
rocks— Echoing their song." Ah, so refined 
and picturesque.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course. It's not like last year, 
when I was recklessly, impossibly 
attempting the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I was so terrified back then that 
Trainer-san's face looked like a 
three-faced Hannya Arhat statue to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That said, I won't let my guard down. I'll 
do everything that needs to be done!
choice_data_list: What am I supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Things like waterfall meditation, 
sitting in zazen, or climbing a mountain 
peak to blow a conch shell.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And I'd also love to win the jackpot on a 
kinako stick at a dusty candy shop on the 
edge of town.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
After exhausting every possible option, we 
leave the rest to fate! That's what you 
call...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best and leave the rest to fate," 
as they say.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Is 'waiting on heaven's will' not a good 
thing? It feels a bit passive, though...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Then let's do this! "Do your best and grab 
your destiny!" Something like that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to grab good fortune with my own 
hands! So let's get training started, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru dashes out under the 
summer sky. It looks like it's going to be 
a hot season.
